maps.sourceLabel: Louisiana Department of Wildlife and Fisheries

profile.sourceEdition: LDWF map linked by the agency; image filename September 2014
profile.quality: Digitized regional agency map · approximate boundaries
profile.interpretation: HNTED digitized the published date bands and registered the image to public Census boundaries. This is an image-derived regional estimate, not an original agency GIS point forecast. HNTED adds a 14-day earlier searching lead to the source breeding band. Map registration, age, sampling and biological variation limit local precision.

registration.method: Explicit fitted Albers/affine coordinate registration; original map CRS unknown
registration.notes: Unresolved or competing source bands are encoded with bit16; missing/obscured footprint is zero. Class neighborhoods are conservative squares. Registration errors are not biological confidence intervals.
